thread:
Support: heads-up — multiple customers reporting 500/503s from hosted API around 10:42 UTC. Appears tied to upstream inference worker crashes during an auth-heavy traffic burst. Posting initial observations and logs.

Deploy-Bot: @channel service infer-runner-nearline-uk restarted (container exit code 139) — automatic restart by k8s. :rotating_light:

eng-sre: seeing repeated segfaults + NVML device resets on the same hosts. p95 latency jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s before 500s. Attaching the most recent error tail.

eng-sre: ```
E 2026-03-18T10:42:11Z infer-runner[pid=23145]: runtime: fatal signal 11 (Segmentation fault)
#0 0x7f8a3b2e in ???
#1 0x55b1c... in kv_prefetch
GPU: NVML: Device 0 reset detected
container: exit code 139
dmesg: [kern] Out of memory: Kill process 23145 (infer-runner) total-vm: 2xxxxkB
```

maya: looks like KV prefetch is ballooning GPU memory during auth-heavy bursts; tipping the driver's memory and causing resets. We also rolled a quantization tweak yesterday that increases h2 memory for cached keys.

luca: oncall is initiating a canary rollback of the latest infer-runner image to the previous revision. Command I ran: `kubectl -n hosted rollout undo deploy/infer-runner --to-revision=9` — monitoring restart tail now.

obs-bot: Alert correlation: auth-proxy request rate + token validation latency spiked at 10:41:50 UTC (x3 baseline). Affected pods tagged nearline-uk2.

cs-jordan: looped in impacted customers and offered fallbacks. Customer A on a high-qps integration requested ETA for a fix; scheduled a call in 30m.

kai: I'll grab coredumps and GPU state from the host. Please run the following on the affected node: `sudo gcore $(pidof infer-runner) || true` and `sudo nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY > /tmp/gpu-mem-$(date +%s).log`. I'll scp artifacts to s3.

maya: mitigation applied: 1) temporarily route auth-heavy traffic to fallback pool (lower-preload CPU-quant model); 2) tightened token rate-limiter for the proxy for the next 20m; 3) disabled the KV prefetch batch growth feature flag. Monitoring CPU/GPU mem and 5xx rate. :white_check_mark:

eng-sre: preliminary RCA hypothesis: a recent quantization memory-layout change + aggressive KV prefetch growth under auth surge -> GPU memory balloon -> cuda driver reset -> segfault in prefetch code path. Next actions: collect full coredumps, compare kernel modules (driver version), and revert quant tweak from yesterday if rollbacks don't clear errors.

luca: rollback completed at 10:46 UTC. New restarts are back to normal on 3/4 nodes; one node still showing GPU reset (we cordoned it for deeper debugging).

obs-bot: metrics update: 5xx rate down from 4.2% -> 0.3% after traffic routing and rollback. p95 latency back to ~150ms.

Support: marking incident P2, creating internal ticket INF-3242 with logs and repro steps. Will follow up in the postmortem.

cs-jordan: I sent the customer an update: "We've routed you to a fallback pool and rolled back a recent change; we're collecting diagnostics and will share a timeline after root cause confirmation."

kai: grabbing coredump + nvml logs now. If anyone needs live access to the node, ping me; I'll keep it available for 1 hour.

eng-sre: follow-ups assigned: (1) collect and upload coredumps and driver logs (kai), (2) validate rollback fully and run soak (luca), (3) run memory-pressure unit test on kv-prefetch path and add guardrails (maya). Will sync at 11:15 UTC for next steps.

Support: thanks all — please post the final writeup and any mitigations for the runbook once confirmed. :pray:
